name: Anchored Sovereign Matrix — bare-metal evaluation reference

author_defined_design_targets.cpu_C_state_pinning: Original source asserts low-level register/C-state pinning; not a measured or implemented feature

safe_implementation.processing: bounded Python hashlib SHA-256 throughput benchmark; sequential candidate nonces; repeat digest checks and mirrored field traversal
safe_implementation.workers: single-process reference; no network or remote workers, no hidden process launch
safe_implementation.cpu_affinity: read/report only when OS allows; never change affinity by default
safe_implementation.cpu_governor: do not change OS power policy, C-states, MSR registers, firmware or BIOS
safe_implementation.benchmark_note: Hashes per second is a local synthetic benchmark; not coin issuance, network acceptance, cryptographic advantage or monetary yield.

measurement_inputs: Measured energy in kWh from a power meter or OS telemetry with documented accuracy
Electricity rate in USD per kWh
Realized, independently verified mining output in USD for the same time window
Hardware model, frequency settings, CPU utilization and elapsed time
source_privacy: No Gmail link details, passwords, hardware device identifiers, addresses, or private server access stored
